channel.title: Holy City Sinner - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Local Charleston Small Business Spotlight: How Modern Tech Helps Shops Grow Faster
item.description: Modern business technology is the practical use of digital tools, intelligent systems, and advanced equipment to improve how companies operate, compete, and grow.

item.title: Point Hope Church hosting Christmas Eve Live Nativity with Petting Zoo and Birthday Cake for Jesus
item.description: Point Hope Church, located at 3404 Turgot Lane in Mount Pleasant, is hosting a free event on Wednesday, Dec. 24 featuring a live nativity with dress-up costumes and animals from All Things Acre Petting Zoo.

item.title: LiveWildFest Returns May 2, 2026; Presale Tickets Launch January 8
item.description: LiveWildFest, Charleston’s homegrown health and wellness festival, will return May 2, 2026, bringing a full day of movement, mindfulness, music and community connection.

item.title: Charleston Battery paired in Prinx Tires USL Cup Group 6 with Richmond, Charlotte, Pittsburgh, Loudoun
item.description: The United Soccer League (USL) confirmed Tuesday the group pairings and match dates for the 2026 edition of the Prinx Tires USL Cup, which pits Championship and League One teams against each other in a World Cup-style tournament.

item.title: Wendy Brewer from Roseate Group of Wells Fargo Advisors named on list of South Carolina’s most impactful business leaders
item.description: Wendy Brewer, Private Wealth Financial Advisor and Partner at Roseate Group of Wells Fargo Advisors, has been named on SC Biz News’ first-ever list of the state’s most powerful and impactful business leaders.

item.title: Charleston Battery’s 2026 USL Championship, Prinx Tires USL Cup schedules released
item.description: The Charleston Battery announced Tuesday the dates and opponents for the club’s 2026 USL Championship and the Prinx Tires USL Cup season. The schedule maps out the Battery’s 34th season in club history.

item.title: Rita’s Seaside Grille to Host “Santa Paws” Holiday Event
item.description: On Saturday, Dec. 20, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., Rita’s Seaside Grille will host an on-site holiday party celebrating furry friends with its “Santa Paws” event.

item.title: The Ryder to host "Celebrate Under the Stars" New Year's Eve Party
item.description: The Ryder Hotel in Charleston is ringing in 2026 with its Celebrate Under the Stars New Year’s Eve party at Little Pine, the hotel’s poolside bar and restaurant.

item.title: Wilkins Named ECHL Player of the Week
item.description: The South Carolina Stingrays, proud ECHL affiliate of the NHL’s Washington Capitals and AHL’s Hershey Bears, are pleased to announce that forward Josh Wilkins has been named the Inglasco ECHL Player of the Week for Dec 8-14.

item.title: Save the Light Half Marathon and 5K set for Feb. 7 on Folly Beach
item.description: The Charleston County Park and Recreation Commission (CCPRC) will partner with Save the Light to host their annual half marathon and 5K, on Saturday, Feb. 7 on Folly Beach. Registration is open through Feb. 4.
